waivers.reason: These 112 endpoints are seven reviewed GTYP control pin families across four CPM5-dedicated quads and four channels. All are driven directly by the CPM hard block. Vendor ip_cpm5.xdc case-analyzes the GT RXUSRCLK/TXUSRCLK pins to zero; the associated setup/hold arcs are already disabled. Accept only this constant-clock coverage list with zero ordinary unconstrained endpoints. See src/xilinx/alveo/versal/bd/README.md.
